name: agentsoma
title_zh: 真机在手的 iPhone 界面操作员，不是模拟器
tagline_zh: 连上实体 iPhone，让 Agent 替你点按滑动输入。适合真机调试、自动化回归、远程帮家人操作——不是截图猜。
tagline_en: Plug in a physical iPhone and let your agent tap, swipe, and type for real. For device testing, UI regression, or.
desc_en: Operate apps on a connected physical iPhone using the AgentSoma CLI. Use when the user asks to use AgentSoma or perform an iPhone UI task. Does not cover desktop or browser automation, or development of AgentSoma itself.
why_zh: 走 AgentSoma CLI 直连系统 UI 树，比坐标盲点稳一个量级。状态可读、动作可回放。
why_en: Talks to the live UI hierarchy via AgentSoma CLI—way more reliable than blind coordinate taps. State is readable, actions.
limit_zh: 只认物理 iPhone（需数据线连本机并装好 AgentSoma CLI）；不覆盖桌面端、浏览器自动化。
limit_en: Physical iPhone only, wired to this machine with AgentSoma CLI installed. No desktop/browser automation, no AgentSoma development. Out of scope, it.
title_en: Drive a real iPhone's UI from your CLI
